title: The Maharashtra University of Health Sciences Act, 1998.
full_text: The Maharashtra University of Health Sciences Act, 1998. Rules Regulations Notifications Orders Circulars Ordinance Statutes SectionsScheduleAnnexureAppendixFormsActdetails Act ID: 199910 Act Number: 10 Enactment Date: 1999-01-21 Act Year: 1999 Short Title: The Maharashtra University of Health Sciences Act, 1998. Long Title: An Act to establish and incorporates a University of Health Science in the State of Maharashtra and to provide for matters connected therewith and incidental thereto. Ministry: Ministry of Govt of Maharashtra Department: Medical Education and Drugs Department Type: STATE Location: Maharashtra Schedule 1.
